programs.title: Alpha
programs.desc: Keda, the young son of a tribe chief, is accidentally left behind and must survive in the wilderness. He then encounters an injured wolf abandoned by its pack and the two form a bond.

programs.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
programs.desc: Josh Lambert and his family relocate to his mother's old house in the hopes of recovering from past trauma. However, they soon encounter strange and chilling paranormal events.

programs.title: Charlie's Angels
programs.desc: Charlie, a wealthy mystery figure, tasks three capable and captivating women with the job of finding Eric Knox, a genius in software development and the leader of Knox Enterprises.

programs.title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
programs.desc: Mike and Marcus face their toughest case yet as their late captain's reputation hangs in the balance. Subsequently, they unravel a complex web of cartel connections in a high-stakes mission.

programs.title: A-X-L
programs.desc: Miles befriends A-X-L, a robotic dog, when he manages to activate its owner-pairing technology. However, Miles's life takes an unusual turn when A-X-L's creators come searching for it.

programs.title: Terminator Salvation
programs.desc: Judgement Day has occurred and Skynet has all but exterminated modern society. Now John Connor leads the resistance against Skynet but is unsure of victory until he encounters Marcus Wright.

programs.title: Life
programs.desc: As astronauts discover the first evidence of extra-terrestrial life on Mars, they begin realising that the life form is extremely intelligent and hostile.

programs.title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
programs.desc: Ben and Zoey find themselves trapped in a series of deadly escape rooms with four others. They try to survive and find a way out as they slowly discover that they have played the game before.

programs.title: Men in Black 3
programs.desc: Agent J of the Men in Black goes back in time to prevent the assassination of his partner, Agent K, at the hands of an alien criminal named Boris the Animal.

programs.title: Venom
programs.desc: Eddie, a journalist, is determined to expose the Life Foundation, for performing unethical experiments on humans. During his investigation, a symbiotic alien merges with him, ensuing chaos.

programs.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programs.desc: After a night of revelry, four friends accidentally run over a man and dump his body to conceal their secret, unaware that the following year brings a series of eerie events in their lives.

programs.title: Hellboy
programs.desc: Hellboy is a demonic warrior who protects the Earth from paranormal threats. When an enemy from his past makes a comeback, it is up to him and his team to stop the villain once and for all.

programs.title: Men in Black: International
programs.desc: Agent M, a probationary member of the MIB, teams up with Agent H and uncovers a sinister plot that reveals a traitor in the organisation aiding an alien invasion.

programs.title: Drunken Master
programs.desc: Wong, a mischievous young boy, learns a special form of martial arts from his alcoholic master in order to prevent an assassin from executing his goals.

programs.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programs.desc: Tired of Chris's professional failures, his wife decides to separate, leaving him financially broke with an unpaid internship in a brokerage firm and his son's custody to deal with.

programs.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programs.desc: Tintin's new model ship sparks an adventure of intrigue and theft. He uncovers a historical mystery involving treasure, rival groups and a quest for scrolls revealing a sunken ship's location.

programs.title: The Cable Guy
programs.desc: Chip, a cable technician, sets his sights on befriending Steven, a new customer whom he takes a fancy to. But when Steven spurns their friendship, Chip immediately starts to wreak havoc in his life.

programs.title: Daddio
programs.desc: A woman takes a cab ride back home from the airport. En route, she unexpectedly has an insightful conversation with the driver regarding the important relationships in life.

programs.title: Hitch
programs.desc: A professional dating expert helps men woo the women of their dreams. However, while helping a hapless client, he finds himself challenged by a gossip columnist.

programs.title: Stuart Little
programs.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programs.title: Anaconda
programs.desc: A documentary crew, who are on a mission to find a tribe named Shirishamas, helps a snake hunter when they find him stranded. However, he forces them to risk their lives and hunt down an anaconda.

programs.title: Brightburn
programs.desc: Tori and Kyle find a baby boy in a spaceship and adopt him as their own child, Brandon. However, after turning 12, Brandon learns that he has superpowers and begins to use them for sinister purposes.

programs.title: The Equalizer
programs.desc: Robert McCall gives up violence and wishes to lead a quiet life. However, brutal events force him to take up the fight for justice once again.

programs.title: Spider-Man 3
programs.desc: A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.

programs.title: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
programs.desc: The Mitchells, a dysfunctional family, must fight a robot apocalypse amidst their much-awaited road trip to save humanity.

programs.title: Monster Hunter
programs.desc: Captain Artemis and her group of soldiers are pulled into a world where dangerous monsters and humans co-exist. Grappled by danger, they must find a way to escape with help from a mysterious hunter.

programs.title: The Equalizer 3
programs.desc: As Robert McCall finds himself forming a new bond with the locals of an Italian town, the region's oppression by the Mafia triggers him to protect his people.

programs.title: Bullet Train
programs.desc: Ladybug, a professional assassin, is assigned to retrieve a briefcase from a bullet train. Soon, he finds himself battling many other killers who board the same train but with a different objective.
